The added spec `spec/models/topic_embed_spec.rb` tests the “new URL creates post” path and the “changed contents updates the post” path, but it does not exercise the unchanged-content branch (where `content_sha1 == embed.content_sha1` and `PostRevisor` must NOT be called). This is a concrete, diff-grounded missing-test gap for newly introduced conditional update logic, and a regression could cause hourly polling to revise/bump topics every time without being caught.
